sources.title: Kazakhstan MFA: memo for citizens travelling to Jordan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.officialityEvidence: Kazakhstan MFA's Amman mission published this ordinary Kazakh-citizen travel memo on 25 May 2025 and names both border and electronic visitor routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of Kazakhstan may obtain a visa on arrival at Queen Alia Airport.

policies.title: Kazakhstani ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA says Kazakh citizens may receive a Jordanian visa on arrival at Queen Alia International Airport.
conditions: The current Kazakhstan MFA memo also identifies Jordan's Interior Ministry portal as an alternative; the stated airport arrival route controls this classification.
Entry point, fees, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
